description: Save a proof document to this computer: the PDF certificate, the evidence package (ZIP with proof.json, the OpenTimestamps file and instructions to verify without SELLAT) or the RFC 3161 token of the qualified seal (.tsr). Never overwrites an existing file.

directory.description: Folder to save into. Default: SELLAT_DOWNLOAD_DIR, else ~/Downloads.

kind.description: certificate = PDF, evidence = ZIP package, tsr = qualified seal token.

lang.description: Language of the certificate or package; use the user's language. Default en.

proof_id.description: The SELLAT proof id (returned by sellat_stamp or sellat_list).

name: sellat_download
title: Download certificate or evidence
